The REST module calls `PatientService.getAllergies` in one main resource class, `PatientAllergyResource2_0`, at three sites. Its test class `PatientAllergyController2_0Test` also calls it at several sites. Nothing else in the module references it. The grep and symbol-reference lookups agree on these 17 call sites.

Best first:

1. **`doGetAll(Patient, RequestContext)`** (`PatientAllergyResource2_0.java:165-183`, call at line 169). Reads the allergy status and maps UNKNOWN to a 204 response, NO_KNOWN_ALLERGIES to an empty list, and SEE_LIST to the allergy items. This is the most sensitive to a change in the return value or status semantics.
2. **`put(String, SimpleObject, RequestContext)`** (`PatientAllergyResource2_0.java:293-313`, call at line 305). Refuses the request when `allergies.isEmpty()` is false, then calls `confirmNoKnownAllergies()` and `setAllergies`. A change to emptiness or status handling would change this guard.
3. **`delete(String, String, String, RequestContext)`** (`PatientAllergyResource2_0.java:210-227`, call at line 222). The "delete all allergies" path iterates over the result of `getAllergies` and voids each entry.
4. **`shouldDeleteAllAllergies`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:91-105`). Asserts the SEE_LIST and UNKNOWN statuses around the delete-all call.
5. **`shouldSaveAllergyWithCodedAllergen`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:148-178`). Calls `getAllergies` at lines 151 and 171.
6. **`shouldSaveAllergyWithNonCodedAllergen`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:179-211`). Calls `getAllergies` at lines 182 and 204.
7. **`shouldSaveAllergyWithReactions`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:212-243`). Calls `getAllergies` at lines 215 and 234.
8. **`shouldThrowExceptionWhenSettingNoKnownAllergiesIfAllergiesNotEmpty`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:260-277`). Calls `getAllergies` at line 264.
9. **`shouldEnsureFetchingAllergiesForPatientThrowsNoContentFoundException`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:278-291`). Exercises the 204 path that `doGetAll` takes for UNKNOWN status. It makes no direct `getAllergies` call, so it is a behavioural dependency rather than a call site.
10. **`shouldSetNoKnownAllergiesIfAllergiesEmpty`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:292-316`). Calls `getAllergies` at lines 295, 301 and 309.
11. **`shouldSaveNewAllergyWithReactionsInOneCall`** (`PatientAllergyController2_0Test.java:317-356`). Calls `getAllergies` at lines 320 and 352.
